android.desc:
No ads, can read inverted codes and can generate barcodes.

Uses the ZXing ("Zebra Crossing") barcode scanning library. Supported barcode formats are: AZTEC, CODABAR, CODE 39, CODE 93, CODE 128, DATA MATRIX, DX FILM EDGE, EAN 8, EAN 13, ITF, MAXICODE (partial), PDF417, QR CODE, Micro QR Code, rMQR Code, RSS 14, RSS EXPANDED, UPC A, UPC E, UPC EAN EXTENSION

This is open source:
https://github.com/markusfisch/BinaryEye

quotes.text:
I seriously hope Google pushes their OEM to include QR code support in the builtin camera app.

This should be a default feature.

That said, if you want a privacy-friendly QR Code reader app on Android, Binary Eye is my recommendation.

GitHub: https://github.com/markusfisch/BinaryEye

Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.markusfisch.android.binaryeye

F-Droid: https://f-droid.org/packages/de.markusfisch.android.binaryeye/
quotes.story_title: Bring back menus, QR codes are terrible
